Deadlines for postgraduate research applications
There is no deadline to apply for research study for most Academic Schools at the University, but there are exceptions.
School-specific deadlines are listed on this page and you should also check your School's funding information.
Deadlines for scholarships and funding may be different.
School of Divinity
Monday 1 December 2026 for acceptance and for School and University funding.
Applications received after the deadline are considered on a rolling basis if places are available.
School of International Relations
Please visit the School of International Relations website for School specific deadlines.
